The render skill's own stated inputs explicitly include "SOP" as a fourth rendering category alongside base/extended/tools ("rendering base+extended+tools+SOP"), and `check_docs.py`'s role census shows exactly one `sop` document for exactly one `workflows` entry — a 1:1 correspondence, not an invented aggregation. Rendering the workflow's own declared step list into one internal-procedure document is therefore a lossless rendering of a distinct, separately-declared source field, not the KB inventing a shortcut the source never authorized. **This is recorded as a judgement call, not smoothed over**: from a solving agent's-eye view, finding this one document does hand over the complete route in one read, which measurably reduces this task's designed problem-tree-discovery difficulty relative to task 0 (which has no comparable SOP). Conclusion: **not scored as KB-BIJECTION RED**, but flagged for visibility since it is the single biggest de-facto solvability shortcut in this difficulty's corpus.
